title: Chapter 30: The Choice Of Refugees
content:
Chapter 30: The Choice Of Refugees

After an interception and blocking battle, the Zergs who survived the war began to clean up the battlefield and deal with the traces of the march along this route.

There were also Zergs who created many traces in different directions to confuse the enemy.

In this process, the Zerg encountered many scattered refugees.

For those refugees who were really desperate, Wu Qing asked the Zerg to guide them in the direction of the fleeing army.

For those refugees who obviously had their own destinations, he sent dogs to follow and scout secretly to see where they were going.

Wu Qing had no ill intentions, but just wanted to find other territories in this way.

The reinforcements of the bear goblin tribe had not arrived, and Wu Qing knew that his blocking mission today was completed.

If the refugees who escaped from the city could reach the next territory before dark, their lives would be saved.

About 8,000 refugees were following the guidance of the host.

It is almost noon now. Wu Qing needs to make arrangements for these refugees as soon as possible. Otherwise, at the speed of the refugees, they may not reach Daxia before dark.

By then, all these refugees will be at the mercy of Weird.

The huge refugee team reached a large lake on a plain, and the host notified everyone to stop and rest.

Many people were exhausted after the intense rush and needed a rest.

Gradually, the people behind caught up.

"Are there any more people behind you? Are the pursuers coming?"

Many people are concerned about this issue.

"There are no other people behind us, and we didn't see the pursuers."

"The pursuers should have been intercepted by the Lord's army!"

"Thank you Lord for your kindness!"

"Thank you Lord for your kindness!"

"Thank you Lord for your kindness!"

"..."

Everyone's thanks were sincere. Without Wu Qing's interception, most of them would not have escaped.

Now the rear has been quiet, and the mysterious race responsible for guidance asked everyone to rest, indicating that the pursuers behind have been intercepted.

Everyone basically gathered at the lake, and the host conveyed Wu Qing's notice.

"The pursuers have been intercepted successfully, and everyone doesn't have to worry about the pursuers now."

Everyone breathed a sigh of relief after hearing this good news clearly.

"Now everyone has two choices."

"The first choice is to continue following the instructions and go to Daxia Territory."

"After going to Daxia Territory, you can join Daxia Territory or not, but you are not allowed to leave privately in a short period of time."

"The second choice is to start from here and go to the destination you want to go by yourself, and you are not allowed to follow the instructions again."

As soon as the two choices came out, everyone thought about how to choose?

The easiest people to make a decision are those ordinary people who have no destination and are only concerned about escaping.

They originally had nowhere to go, and they may not have been to the second territory in their lives. Now they are in the wild, and they are even more panicked.

Now there is a territory to stay in, and there is an army escort, so of course they are willing to continue to follow.

Daxia Territory is willing to take them in, which is even more desirable for them.

This kind of people accounts for about half of the total number, about 4,000 people.

As long as these people join Daxia Territory, Wu Qing will make a lot of money this time.

The remaining half of the people are mainly from the Tengu clan. They are the main race of the destroyed territory and the main race in this area. They have more choices.

Some of them have connections with the upper class and can go to other territories to continue to live a good life;

Some people have relatives and friends in other territories who can accept them, which is much better than going to a completely unfamiliar territory;

Some people are businessmen and have some industries in other territories and must rush there;

Others are originally subordinates of the original lord and have tasks to do.

There are all kinds of reasons, and they are endless.

The choice of these people is much more difficult. If they make the wrong choice, it may be a dead end.

If they follow Daxia Territory, their safety should be guaranteed, and they can intercept the pursuit of the evil god army. The strength of this territory will not be weak.

But if they follow Daxia Territory, they will lose their freedom for a period of time and may have to live a hard life for a period of time.

If they do not go to Daxia Territory and go to the planned destination by themselves, the variables will be much greater.

The current route deviates from the planned route of most people, and it is still uncertain whether we can reach the next territory.

If there is a delay and we cannot reach the next territory, we will definitely die.

Moreover, traveling during the day is not necessarily safe, and there are many dangers in the wild.

At first, in order to escape, there was no way to consider so much, and we could only gamble. Now that there is a safe option, people are very hesitant.

This is a trade-off between pros and cons.

"Let's go to Daxia Territory!"

"Let's go too!"

"..."

At this time, many people have made decisions and discussed aloud.

"We are also willing to go to Daxia Territory!"

At this time, a crisp voice attracted everyone's attention.

The speaker is a very petite and peculiar girl. She is about 1.5 meters tall, which is very short among this group of people.

She has emerald green hair and pointed ears. The most eye-catching thing is her transparent wings like a butterfly.

She has a delicate appearance and her eyes are particularly large and bright.

Beside her, there is a group of people of the same tribe, all of whom look like women.

"You, the Flower Fairy Clan, must come with us! You can't choose for yourself!"

They were surrounded by the Tengu Clan, and a dog-headed man with a scar on his face came forward and warned sternly.

"Why? Now that the territory is gone, we still have to listen to you?"

The Flower Fairy girl who spoke was a little scared, but she still mustered up the courage to refute.

The Flower Fairy Clan members around her all gathered around her, and many of them looked dissatisfied.

"Just because you are the private property of the Lord! We must take you back!"

The dog-headed man had a knife on his waist, and he held the handle of the knife and answered fiercely.

He was not afraid of the Lord who was behind him, because his Lord had a deep background and did not need to be afraid of anyone in this area.

The Flower Fairy Clan caused internal conflicts, and Wu Qing also noticed the situation here at this time.

"What private property! We were just fooled!"

The flower fairy girl was even more scared when she saw the dog-headed man's knife. At this moment, two insect dogs came over and gave her courage. She said something again.

"Clang!"

The dog-headed man's steel knife was unsheathed!

"Ah!"

The flower fairy girl was not very brave and screamed in fear.

The irrelevant people watching around couldn't help but stretch their necks to see what the result would be.

The two dogs came in front of the flower fairy girl and separated her from the dog-headed man.

"This is our private matter, you'd better get out of the way!"

The scarred dog-headed man said coldly to the two dogs.

Wu Qing was a little helpless when he heard this.

"Another self-righteous dog thing."
